c32a5e70:  .;
 .;DGJOTP1 is a routine in the Mumps programming language. It is used to
 .;generate various types of reports for the Decentralized Hospital
 .;Computer Program (DHCP).
4e918839: ;If division is needed, perform it and quit if an error occurs.
ba5b32bb: ;If no division is needed, set the default division.
eb23d0bd: ;Call the appropriate routine based on the selected report type.
63631bf7: ;Retrieve and format the date range for the report.
6ab1d8e7: ;Set up screening logic to select only certain types of reports.
e5c5ac91: ;Prompt the user to select the desired summary type.
fc928805: ;Warn the user that the report requires 132-column output.
e191144e: ;Set the current date and format it for the report.
d716fabb: ;Set up variables and call the appropriate routine to handle report output.
e3024709: If an error occurs while preparing the device environment, quit.
4cb56e0b: Main processing loop: Loop through all entries in the VA SUPERVISORY MOVEMENT file and process each entry.
9d5145a1: If the report type is a monthly inpatient summary, jump to the routine DGJOTP2 to process the data and generate the report.
b703b32d: If the report type is a monthly outpatient summary, jump to the routine DGJOTP3 to process the data and generate the report.
961bb1f8: If no data is found in the temporary global, display a 'NO RECORDS' message.
a66c7603: Exit point for the routine.
9cb4e7c0: Calculate the total percentage for the combined high-risk categories (2, 3, and 4).
5493fff8: Update the total count and high-risk count for the current division in the DGJTOT array.
adda6316: If the report is sorted by physician, update the physician-specific totals in the DGJPHTOT array and call the PC subroutine to update additional statistics.
56bfadf4: If the report is sorted by service, call the PC subroutine to update additional statistics.
f5430412: ; Count patient by treatment specialty and service.
f0e38ddc: ; Count patient by treatment specialty, service and specialty.
a030d84d: ; Return to main routine.
51213538: ; Quit if facility division is specified but not found.
19f818e4: ; Quit if division does not match specified division.
d16bf1d0: ; Quit if only outpatient is selected but record is inpatient.
b5c89b56: ; Quit if only inpatient is selected but record is outpatient.
4c9c9f30: ; Quit if discharge summary and no admission date.
167f0529: ; Set pointer value for physician or service.
b35987f5: ; Quit if not valid report type.
042d8adc: Exclude record if service/team filter is enabled and current record's service/team is not in the filter list.
f9a8bf2b: Exclude record if specialty filter is enabled and current record's specialty is not in the filter list.
14b06133: Exclude record if summary type filter is enabled and current record's summary type is not in the filter list.
c84af552: Exclude record if it falls outside the date range selected.
584b1336: Exclude record if it fails additional filter/screening criteria.
b67bc0eb: Initialize divisional totals for the current division if not already done.
0e4d80b9: Initialize divisional totals for the current division if not already done (service view).
c193154f: Retrieve patient name from the PATIENT file.
8e7acced: Store record details in utility global (physician view). Accumulate divisional and physician totals.
750e71ee: Retrieve service and specialty names from their respective files (service view).
62d51f96: ;Store data for each physician or service.
0ba7fb44: ;Quit if all records have been processed.
da0a2ea6: ;Update totals for physician or service.
bda7c2ac: ;Store updated totals for the physician.
af28571e: ;Store updated totals for the service.
4e9eefd7: ;Exit after storing totals.
102e4cea: ;Calculate grand totals for physician or service.
477d1f58: ;Exit after calculating grand totals.
2cbef471: ;Prompt user to select a physician.
bea1dd8d: ;Exit if no physician selected.
61d9a2ca: ;Select service(s) to include in the report.
